forwarder_said: "2 of the 4 pallets ready, about 1,200 kg... Please keep the 2 pallets on SVZ 201"
message_to_send: Dear Arjun, thank you for your update. We have noted that you will ship 2 of the 4 pallets, about 1,200 kg, on SVZ 201 under booking B-02, and the other 2 pallets go next week. The controller will confirm the change. Solvane Air Cargo capacity team.
why: The forwarder gave up 2 of 4 pieces, about 1,200 kg, in writing; release exactly that and reduce volume in proportion: 14.4 m3 x 2/4 = 7.2 m3 (Space 3.3, 5.1). Under 2,000 kg so no senior approval needed. Sources: booking B-02, forwarder F-02, message M-02, Space 3.1, Space 3.3.
